title: Artificial Intelligence and the Law: Case Studies, Challenges, and Future Trends
description: AI is changing legal work through research tools, contract analysis, case review, compliance checks, and uncomfortable questions about accountability.
short_description: A plain-English look at legal research, contracts, evidence, compliance, and the expensive consequences of getting automated law wrong.
author: Jonathan Harris
audience: A clear, no-hype briefing on AI in law for lawyers, compliance teams, policy readers, and anyone tracking legal change.
